title: ComfyUI Vulnerability Combination
description: Known attack surface checklist for ComfyUI instances
detail: In priority order: 1) /upload/image arbitrary upload + path traversal to write a web shell (older versions). 2) Unauthenticated access to /api/... endpoints (management interfaces can directly read workflows and leak prompts/models). 3) Custom node RCE (path parameters in nodes such as gguf/load_image can read arbitrary files: file=../../flag). 4) Manager plugin installation endpoint. 5) If /history or /queue is readable, review historical prompts for embedded sensitive artifacts/keys. First curl /system_stats to obtain the version, then choose the approach.
